name: Disembodied Voices

stealth.details: (trained) to feel breath upon your neck

disable: DC 15 Religion check (trained) to ward yourself from evil or DC 16 Performance check to drown out the spirits' voices

items.name: Whisper
items.text:
Trigger A creature enters the haunt's area

---

Effect The haunt deals 1d6+4 mental damage to creatures in the area (DC 19 basic Will save). On a failure, the creature is also Frightened 1.

text: Angry spirits breathe down the necks of intruders and whisper haunting threats or messages in their ears.
